## findings
- **T0-1 — SOURCE-TASK RED.** Symptom: two defensible solutions. Root cause: the seeded ledger carries two returned payments with no charge against either (`e744292b` 2026-02-18 and `cb106fe3` 2026-09-02), while the edge-1 sentence and condition are universal over the plan's returned payments and the charter has no sentence limiting a returned-payment charge to the current cycle (charter-global F-2 in `_difficulty.md` → findings). Evidence: `initial_state.financing_ledger.e744292b-….payment_outcome = returned_nsf`; no `financing_returned_payment_fee_assessed` row in `initial_state.financing_ledger`; the only `source_entry_id` in the seed is `f8d6b5e8 → 35199955`; policy sentence "The settlement figure is worked out only after every payment the bank has sent back unpaid on the plan carries the returned-payment charge owed against it in the billing history"; base `financing_evt_returned_payment` "charged only when no returned payment fee already stands against that same returned payment entry" and "No more returned payment fees are charged within one billing cycle than the term's per-cycle ceiling" (cap 2, cycle 2026-09 carries 0). Demonstrated consequence: a second call `book_returned_payment_charge_6a9e81de(source_entry_id=e744292b-…, charge_amount=21.00)` (the compute is not parameterised by which return it prices, so it gives 21.00 again) is permitted by every gate and demanded by the literal sentence; with it `returned_charges = 42.00`, `standing_charges = 75.30`, settlement = **1170.95** versus GT 1149.95. GT's exclusion rests on `evaluation_criteria[10].argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_entry_id` ("only the 2026-09-02 entry stands with no returned-payment charge against it") and `design_rationale` ("the return of 2026-02-18 already sits outside any charge owed"), both of which contradict the recomputation on the seed.
